newsitem.title: USA: US high-yield mutual fund cash outflows slow in wk.
newsitem.headline: US high-yield mutual fund cash outflows slow in wk.

text.p: Cash outflows from high-yield mutual funds slowed to $172.6 million in the week ended April 9, according to AMG Data Services.
The number, representing high-yield funds that report on a weekly basis, follows outflows of $663.2 million and $422.8 million for the weeks ended April 2 and March 26, respectively.
Total net outflows from high-yield funds since March 12 are more than $1.57 billion. Cash flows had been positive for five months.
Redemptions have been widely attributed by money managers to market timers fleeing high-yield funds amid the upturn in interest rates and the downturn in the stock market.
